events.text: Layer 1 (b704d3dfc): parts-props render live in the loader overlay via resolvePropParts. Layer 2 (in flight): MESH props (imported/cooked like 'pepes') render live by REFERENCING an already-resident mesh — new host doors __compiled_world_set/clear_live_mesh_props, world_loader applyLiveMeshProps appends a mesh-prop draw per ref each frame (FNV-1a key-hash → loaded mesh, material_ref 0 = no per-frame alloc), JS meshPropLiveRefs packs (hash,x,y,z,yaw). Shipping the Zig now.

USER RULING (req_1836): the parts-props vs mesh-props split is confusing to both of us — soon FOLD the ambiguity, converging on the MESH approach as the canonical one prop representation (user: 'the mesh approach is the better one imo'). Fold = preserve parts-props' behaviors, but every prop becomes addressable as a resident-mesh reference. Deferred follow-up, pairs with the mesh-zoo dev room.

resolution: Placed mesh props (pepes etc.) now render INSTANTLY in the loader iso pane with no rebake — user confirmed 'that is instant'. Root cause: the live overlay only handled box/parts geometry; mesh props (imported genmesh / Studio-cooked) carry real mesh assets and were skipped, and a pure prop placement bumps mapBuildRev not worldRev so it never baked on its own → forever invisible. Fix renders a just-placed mesh prop by REFERENCING an already-resident mesh (the user's 'once one X exists the next is a reference' model): new host doors __compiled_world_set/clear_live_mesh_props carry (FNV-1a keyHash,x,y,z,yaw) per placement; world_loader.applyLiveMeshProps appends a real mesh-prop draw per ref each frame (hash→loaded mesh via built-once map, material_ref 0 = the mesh's own baked texture, no per-frame alloc), surviving both streaming and monolithic node paths. Parts-props also now render live via resolvePropParts. SHAs b704d3dfc (parts), 89c32b54e (mesh). Follow-ups tracked: mesh-zoo dev room for never-placed kinds + folding the parts/mesh split onto the mesh approach (req_1836).
